title: Automated Neural Network Auditing (ANNA) for Energy Market Settlements: A Machine and Reinforcement Learning-Based Approach
abstract: arXiv:2611.30020v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The integration of segmented energy markets into Independent System Operators (ISOs) like CAISO and MISO has increased settlement complexity. Automated transaction processing creates challenges for evaluating accuracy, compliance, and financial integrity. Traditional rule-based manual auditing is inefficient, error-prone, and cannot handle the data volume from automated markets.This research proposes Automated Neural Network Auditing (ANNA), a machine and reinforcement learning framework for settlement auditing via anomaly prioritization. ANNA integrates statistical anomaly detection, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), clustering, and Deep Q-Network (DQN) reinforcement learning to flag potentially anomalous transactions from historical market data. translated_title: 面向能源市场结算的自动化神经网络审计（ANNA）：一种基于机器学习与强化学习的方法
translated_abstract: 分段能源市场整合进CAISO和MISO等独立系统运营商（ISO）后，增加了结算的复杂性。自动化交易处理为评估准确性、合规性和财务完整性带来了挑战。传统的基于规则的人工审计效率低下、容易出错，且无法处理自动化市场产生的海量数据。本研究提出了自动化神经网络审计（ANNA），这是一种通过异常优先级排序实现结算审计的机器学习与强化学习框架。ANNA整合了统计异常检测、K近邻（KNN）、聚类以及深度Q网络（DQN）强化学习，从历史市场数据中标记潜在异常交易。该方法被评估为一种分析师支持工具，用于对需要进一步审计审查的交易进行优先级排序。ANNA与传统统计方法、基于聚类的技术等（摘要在此处截断）进行了对比测试。
tldr: 本文提出ANNA框架，通过整合统计异常检测、K近邻、聚类与深度Q网络强化学习，对能源市场结算交易进行异常优先级排序，作为分析师支持工具高效识别自动化市场中需要重点审计的潜在异常交易。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ANNA, a machine and reinforcement learning framework integrating statistical anomaly detection, KNN, clustering, and Deep Q-Network (DQN) reinforcement learning to prioritize potentially anomalous energy market settlement transactions, serving as an analyst-support tool for efficient auditing of automated markets.
